title: Knowledge Memory Run Metrics
description: Per-run routed-review metrics, derived from the run's routing decisions and Survey review decisions so review cost per caught defect can be measured. `reviewSeconds` is selection-to-submission dwell from Survey session events, an upper bound on attention; it is null when no events were supplied, never estimated. Shares are null when their denominator is zero.

decisions.description: Routing decisions made this run (claims and entity changes).

claimsProposed.description: Claim changes recorded as proposed this run, routed or not.

routedByRule.description: Routing reasons per rule. A change with several reasons counts once under each.

pending.description: Routed changes with no reviewer decision yet.

unmatched.description: Reviewer decisions that name no routed change of this run; not counted in decisions.

annotated.description: Review decisions that only annotated a routed item: an agent's, a rule's or an unattested reviewer's. They promote nothing and leave the item pending; only a human reviewer's decision promotes a routed claim.

reviewTimedDecisions.description: Reviewer decisions whose dwell is in reviewSeconds. A total over fewer decisions than were made understates review time; compare with reviewer.decisions.
